title: Responsive, accessible and performance refinement
implementation_steps: Exercise all target viewports, zoom, forced colors, reduced motion and reduced transparency.
Run automated accessibility checks and manual keyboard/screen-reader workflows.
Test unsupported blur fallback and unusually long content.
Measure editor performance with representative 1000-table/10000-ticket workload and optimize blur/rendering.
acceptance_criteria: No critical/serious automated accessibility violations remain; manual findings are resolved or explicit blockers.
All ordinary pages reflow at 320 CSS px.
No sustained visible interaction stutter on documented reference hardware.
Original functional performance targets remain satisfied.

title: Visual regression and cross-browser verification
implementation_steps: Create deterministic screenshots for critical screens and component states.
Test current available Chromium, Firefox and WebKit engines; record exact versions.
Freeze fixture dates, fonts and animations for repeatable visual checks.
Manually inspect canvas, transparent layers, PDF pages and focus states.
Rerun relevant original acceptance tests after UI integration.
acceptance_criteria: Screenshots cover target viewports and error/loading/conflict states.
Differences are reviewed, not blindly accepted.
No regressions in imports, holds, assignments, publication or email confirmation.

title: Design-system and implementation handover
implementation_steps: Document token usage, glass limits, component parameters and responsive rules.
Document backend prerequisites still blocked and actual test evidence.
Provide before/after screenshots from implemented screens, not mockups.
Add exact UI test commands and fixture setup to README.
acceptance_criteria: New screens can use shared components without bespoke visual rules.
Completion claims correspond to actual integrated behavior and evidence.

criteria: Olive/lime/ivory identity consistent across every screen.
Hierarchy, spacing, type and component states are coherent.
No clipping, overlap, unstable loading layout or decorative glass on dense data.
Contrast requirements met for solid and composited backgrounds.
Reduced transparency/motion, forced colors and zoom/reflow verified.
Original domain protections and permission boundaries preserved.
No placeholder actions masquerading as working features.
Server failures, stale writes and ambiguous delivery remain visible.
Initial blur budget of at most three visible regions respected or deviations supported by measurements.
Editor drag preview aims for 60 fps on documented reference desktop; test under representative workload.
Existing p95 assignment and initial layout performance targets remain unchanged.
A4/A3 output uses readable solid backgrounds and controlled ink usage.
Selected publication and privacy settings match generated artifact.

automated: Django integration tests for changed forms/views.
axe-core or equivalent automated accessibility scans.
Token contrast checks plus manual composited-surface verification.
manual: Screen-reader form errors, import preview and check-in.
PDF page rendering and print preview review.
Mobile touch and representative large-layout interaction.
validation_strategy.evidence: Record browser/runtime versions, viewport, fixture, result and screenshot/artifact path for each gate. Do not mark accessibility compliance solely from automated scans.

definition_of_done: UI01–UI12 completed with real integrations or remaining blockers explicitly listed.
Required brand palette and restrained glass system applied consistently.
Business workflows and original acceptance invariants preserved.
Visual, accessibility, functional, performance and print gates pass.
UI documentation, deterministic fixtures and reproducible validation commands delivered.
suggested_cursor_prompt: Read CURSOR_UI_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.json together with SPECIFICATION.md and CURSOR_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.json. Audit the actual application, then implement the new professional Liquid Glass UI in dependency order. Use #283113, #F3FF74 and #F5F4ED with the defined semantic tokens. Preserve Django templates, backend rules, accessibility and working behavior. Track progress and actual evidence in UI_IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.json; do not mark missing backend integrations complete.
